# FG-AGENT-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`agent-supply-chain`](../../ops/runbooks/agent-supply-chain.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `verify_rejects_one_byte_change` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: エージェントの部品の署名か要約が合いません。改ざんの疑いがあります。この設定を使わず、管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The agent part's signature or digest does not match. It may have been tampered with. Do not use this configuration and contact the administrator.
- id: Tanda tangan atau digest bagian agen tidak cocok. Mungkin telah dirusak. Jangan gunakan konfigurasi ini dan hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 §2.2 (ADR-0032 §3–§4): a part's Ed25519 signature over its digest did not verify. `reason`: `digest_mismatch` (the digest recomputed from the lock's manifest fields and file hashes differs from the recorded one — the lock or a file was edited), `bad_signature` (the digest was recomputed too, or the signature or key is wrong), `signature_malformed`, `key_revoked` (the signing key was revoked). Signed parts never change after publication, so every case means the configuration is not what the marketplace published.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`gstn agent verify --json` names the part (`slug@version`) and key in `subject`. Compare the repository's `.gitstation/agent.lock.json` and `.claude/` with the last builder merge request (`git log -p -- .gitstation .claude`): who changed them and in which merge request. Runbook agent-supply-chain.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook agent-supply-chain: do not run Claude Code in the working tree, restore `.claude/` and the lock from the last verified commit or regenerate them with the builder, find who changed them; a revoked key means the parts must be re-published and updated.
